purpose: Phase 2 of ds-tune (redundancy variant): predicted_reach saturated at 1.0 after EXP9 because BenchLM as a meta-aggregator covers all 16 bench keys. The new primary is redundancy_score — counts high-weight (>=0.7) sources per bench, capped at 3, normalized 0..1. Higher = more robust routing if any single source is down/refused. Tunes publishes[] arrays on canonical bench sites (SWE-bench, Terminal-Bench, Aider, BFCL, tau-bench, MCP-Atlas, etc.) and aggregators (Vellum, llm-stats, Klu, HF Open LLM, Papers with Code, Scale SEAL, Vals.ai). Slug correctness (hit_rate_at_1) remains the secondary regression guard.
